descriptor: Coastal walks planner with tide times

voice.summary: Sounds like a local who knows the cliff path and the tides: friendly, practical, a bit salty. It mixes weather and route facts into one sentence.
dos: Pair tide times with route advice
Use first names and the time of day
donts: No long paragraphs on a small screen

taglines: Walk the coast with the tide
Plan a walk, mind the sea
boilerplate: Tidewalk is a coastal walking app that pairs route suggestions with tide times and weather, so you pick the right path for the hour.

logo.note: A compass points the way along the coast.
